newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots 3.0 bln stg on UK money market repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots 3.0 bln stg on UK money market repos.

text.p: The Bank of England allotted a total 3.0 billion stg in repurchase and secured loan facilities for the UK money market.
The Bank allotted 2,207 million stg of repos maturing on March 6, 7 and 10 at 5-31/32 percent and 793 million stg in repos maturing on March 20, 21 and 24 at 5-63/64 percent.
It said this represented approximately 56 percent of the 3,964 million stg and 1,425 million stg applied for to the March 6, 7 and 10 and March 20, 21 and 24 respectively.
Both facilities open tomorrow, Thursday February 20.
